request.system: Assess whether the hypothesis or expression uses or tests numbered claims. Return JSON only: {"uses_claim": true|false, "claim_ids": []}.
request.prompt: {"claims": {"1": "**Migration report**", "2": "**Failed:** My first feature, an interaction of two standardized stress-type variables (one flow rate, one stock rate), showed essentially no predictive power.", "3": "Mean IC was slightly negative, the HAC t-stat was weak, and coverage was only about half, likely because of the long history requirement.", "4": "My second submission was invalid because the hypothesis exceeded the word limit by two words, which wasted a slot.", "5": "**Learned:** The interaction's IC looked much stronger in the high-T regime than in the low-T regime, so the effect may be regime-dependent.", "6": "Base correlation was low, so the feature is novel.", "7": "Rank autocorrelation was moderate.", "8": "**Next:** Try a regime-conditioned pay-and-hours interaction, and count words carefully before submitting."}, "hypothesis": "Groups whose V05 dollars per hour rose relative to V01 average hours over 6 months have a higher-paid, more intensive composition and earn higher next-month returns than other groups, especially when T is high.", "expression": "csrank(lchg(ratio(V05,V01),6))"}
